B.explanation: La diferencia señalada se refiere a la propiedad. La forma individual no elimina obligaciones ni define por sí sola canal o cantidad de trabajadores.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

B.indicatorText: Identifies rules, skills and expected behaviors at the workplace in a contact centers or call centers.
B.stem:
Read the contact center notice: Agents must sign in five minutes before their shift to check system access. Personal devices must remain in lockers during customer calls. Report access problems to the shift leader; do not use a coworker's account.

Why should agents sign in early?
options: To check that they can access the system.
To finish their shift five minutes early.
To record personal calls before work.
To lend their account to another agent.
B.explanation: El aviso vincula el ingreso anticipado con comprobar acceso al sistema; no autoriza salir antes ni compartir cuentas.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

Where should personal devices be during customer calls?
options: On the customer service desk.
With the shift leader at all times.
Inside the shared headset box.
In lockers.
B.explanation: El texto indica expresamente que los dispositivos personales deben permanecer en los casilleros durante las llamadas.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

options: Use a coworker's account.
Ignore the assigned shift.
Ask a customer for a password.
Inform the shift leader.

B.indicatorText: Recognizes specific information in written conversations and dialogues about dealing with others.
B.stem:
Read the dialogue. Customer: I received the blue case, but I ordered a green one. Agent: I am sorry about the mix-up. Could you send the order number? Customer: Yes. I would prefer a replacement, not a refund.

What is the customer's problem?
options: The case arrived with no payment record.
The customer ordered two green cases.
The delivered case has the wrong color.
The package has not arrived at all.
B.explanation: El cliente contrasta azul recibido con verde solicitado; no informa falta de entrega.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

B.indicatorText: Recognizes specific information in written conversations and dialogues about dealing with others.

What solution does the customer prefer?
options: A refund.
A second blue case.
Cancellation of a future order.
A replacement.
B.explanation: La preferencia se expresa explícitamente: un reemplazo, no devolución de dinero.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

Read the training manual: A knowledge base is a collection of approved articles that agents use to answer common questions. Search by keywords and check the article's update date before sharing instructions.

What does knowledge base mean in this text?
options: A list of customers' passwords.
A schedule of agents' holidays.
A collection of approved help articles.
A record of personal purchases.
B.explanation: La definición se encuentra en la primera oración: artículos aprobados para resolver preguntas frecuentes.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

B.indicatorText: Reads technical written information at workplace.
B.stem:
Read the headset guide: Connect the headset before opening the calling application. Select it as the input and output device. Make a test call. If the microphone is muted, press the mute button once and test again.

What is the first step?
options: Open a customer case.
Connect the headset.
Press mute repeatedly.
Change the customer password.
B.explanation: La secuencia empieza conectando el equipo antes de abrir la aplicación.

As both the input and output device.

B.indicatorText: Reads texts about work related situation about protocols to assist people with disabilities in a professional context.
B.stem:
Read the accessibility protocol: Address the customer directly, even when a companion is present. Ask whether assistance is wanted before helping. Do not move a wheelchair, cane or other personal aid without permission.

Who should the agent address directly?
options: Only the companion.
The customer.
Any nearby employee instead of the customer.
Only the person who made the appointment.
B.explanation: El protocolo pide dirigirse a la persona cliente aun cuando esté acompañada.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

B.indicatorText: Reads texts about work related situation about protocols to assist people with disabilities in a professional context.
B.stem:
Read the accessibility protocol: Address the customer directly, even when a companion is present. Ask whether assistance is wanted before helping. Do not move a wheelchair, cane or other personal aid without permission.

What must happen before an agent moves a personal aid?
options: The companion must leave the room.
The customer must give permission.
The agent must assume assistance is needed.
The appointment must be canceled.
B.explanation: No se deben mover ayudas personales sin permiso; la intención de ayudar no sustituye esa autorización.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

B.indicatorText: Reads examples commercial documents with a variety of topics: purchases, sales, requests, claims, payments, others depending of the type of document required.

How many desk lamps are requested?

Where must the lamps be delivered?

To the email provider's office.
To the supplier's warehouse only.
To each employee's home.

Delivery alone does not confirm that payment was made.
The invoice must be paid before it can be sent.
The order cancels the need for an invoice.

B.indicatorText: Recognizes what is said in a personal email or posting even where some colloquial language is used based on cross-cultural communication and different accents by reading articles, magazines or newspapers.
B.stem:
Read the email: Hi Sara, thanks for covering my shift. I owe you one! Please keep me posted if the client sends the missing file. I will be back on Wednesday. Best, Leo.

What does keep me posted mean here?
options: Send me a printed poster.
Change the client's mailing address.
Publish my schedule on social media.
Keep me informed about any update.
B.explanation: La expresión idiomática pide mantenerse informado sobre novedades; no se refiere a un cartel ni a una publicación pública.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

B.indicatorText: Recognizes what is said in a personal email or posting even where some colloquial language is used based on cross-cultural communication and different accents by reading articles, magazines or newspapers.
B.stem:
Read the email: Hi Sara, thanks for covering my shift. I owe you one! Please keep me posted if the client sends the missing file. I will be back on Wednesday. Best, Leo.

Why does Leo say I owe you one?
options: To confirm a formal debt of one dollar.
To express appreciation for Sara's help.
To ask Sara for another missing file.
To reject the shift change.
B.explanation: En este contexto informal expresa agradecimiento y disposición a corresponder el favor; no constituye una deuda monetaria específica.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

B.indicatorText: Selects specific details from an employee's evaluation form to identify areas for development related to quality service by underlying and organizing ideas.
B.stem:
Read the employee evaluation. Agent: Luis. Strengths: polite greetings and accurate identity checks. Development need: case notes often omit the agreed next step. Action: use the closing checklist in every case. Review date: April 30.

Which area needs improvement?
options: Giving polite greetings.
Recording the agreed next step in case notes.
Performing accurate identity checks.
Arriving before the review date.
B.explanation: La necesidad de desarrollo se identifica expresamente en el registro incompleto del siguiente paso.
B.origin: Ítem original de práctica; no aplicado ni validado por el MEP.

B.indicatorText: Selects specific details from an employee's evaluation form to identify areas for development related to quality service by underlying and organizing ideas.

What action is recommended?
options: Stop recording notes to save time.
Use the closing checklist in every case.
Skip identity checks for returning customers.
Wait until April 30 before changing anything.
B.explanation: La acción propuesta es utilizar una lista de cierre en cada caso, no esperar a la fecha de revisión.

B.indicatorText: Selects specific details from an employee's evaluation form to identify areas for development related to quality service by underlying and organizing ideas.
